style.prompt: Create a 16:9 side-by-side before-and-after comparison image split down the middle into two equal panels. LEFT panel: the input kitchen photo exactly as it is, unchanged (wood cabinets, beige tiles, clutter). RIGHT panel: the same kitchen, same room layout, same camera angle and framing, realistically renovated: white shaker-style cabinets with simple hardware, light oak countertops, white subway tile backsplash, clean empty counters with no clutter, bright natural light, photorealistic interior photo. Add a clean label in the top-left corner of the left panel reading exactly "Before" and a label in the top-left corner of the right panel reading exactly "After", white bold sans-serif text on a dark rounded box. No other text.
